title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals
description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Associate Professor, and Curator of Mammals at Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark wishes to appoint a Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals (mammalia) with a great vision for natural history museums in a changing world. Duties are divided equally between collection-based research and other museum duties including curation of the mammal collections, research-based teaching and supervision of students, public engagement work, and to act as the museum's liaison with relevant Danish natural history communities. The successful applicant will be expected to establish and develop an externally funded collection-based research programme/group and publish in influential journals. We particularly encourage applications from applicants with a collection-based research specialization on mammalogy. The successful applicant will be expected to curate the museum’s historically important mammal collections (56.000 specimens) requiring a thorough understanding and practical knowledge of mammal classification. We value collaboration across disciplines and professions. All applicants are expected to demonstrate interdisciplinary thinking and a commitment to working together to create solutions to global challenges. This also goes for collection work. Curators develop the collections that they are responsible for through research, field work, loan activities, digitization, acting as scientific host for visiting researchers, and increasing accessibility for everyone. This curatorial position in Mammalogy at the Natural History Museum Denmark will be filled at either the Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level. All curators at the Natural History Museum Denmark are expected to take a leading role in society as advocates for science and nature, creating impact at all levels while actively promoting the museum’s Vision and Values (https://snm.dk/en/about-museum). Further details of qualifications required for appointment at the museum are detailed below.

The position is available starting March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Qualifications
Tenure-track assistant professor
Applicants at the tenure track assistant professor level are expected to have an academic record demonstrating the potential to deliver high profile internationally competitive research in the area of specialization. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have experience with collection-based research. Previous experience curating natural history collections and university teaching experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement at the time of hiring for tenure-track assistant professors. Documented interest in and experience with public engagement and community-based activities is expected. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar institution is an advantage.

Associate professor
Applicants at the associate professor level are expected to have a strong publication record in high-level, international, peer-reviewed venues in the area of specialization and a track record of successful external research funding. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have significant experience with collection-based research. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar is expected. Curatorial expertise and considerable previous experience and impact with curating and developing natural history collections is required at associate professor level. Broad experience and a compelling vision for public engagement and community-based activities is essential. Candidates are also required to have documented university-level competencies in delivering high-quality undergraduate/graduate teaching and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

Assessment of applicants
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research as well as their curatorial experience and potential to curate one or more of the museum’s collections. Teaching and public engagement qualifications and experience will be considered according to career level. The overall fit for the Natural History Museum will also be considered.
Ideal applicants will have the following qualifications:

  • An outstanding reputation for high-quality research within Mammalogy
  • A record of scientific use of museum collections and/or data
  • A proven track record of interdisciplinary research
  • Scientific expertise that ensures ability to curate Mammalia collections held by the museum
  • Curatorial experience improving and developing natural history collections
  • Experience from a natural history museum or similar
  • Participation in national and international museum collaborations through organizations and programs.
  • A vision for how digital, genomic, and other new technologies will drive advances in natural history science
  • Ability to work at a strategic level
  • A track record of public engagement and creating impact beyond academia
  • Experience working on museum exhibitions, interpretation, and/or public engagement
  • Experience in fundraising and ability to attract research funding from external sources for research, digitization and collection development.
  • Supportive and collaborative people skills and commitment to an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and respect for everyone with equality and opportunity for all
  • A passion for the vision and values of the Natural History Museum Denmark
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Confidence in ability to provide advocacy for the museum with multiple stakeholders
University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor/associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.
For tenure-track assistant professors
For associate professors

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

Information on the tenure-track programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period, tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

About the Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark is the Danish national museum for nature. We work to empower citizens to connect with nature with the aim to create positive change for people and planet. We want to inspire, engage, and enable people to enjoy, understand, and care for the diversity of the natural world. The impact of climate change and anthropogenic forces on biodiversity has reached a critical point. We firmly believe that natural history museums can and should play a key role towards a more sustainable relationship with nature. We are opening a new Danish national museum for nature in spring 2027. One big museum site, in the Botanical Garden, in the centre of Copenhagen, will host state-of-the-art laboratories, outstanding research collections, new public galleries, and combined facilities for programming, education, and citizen science. It is an ambition for the museum to enhance natural history and inspire curiosity, knowledge, and empowerment for the future. The Botanical Garden was founded in 1600, and the museum’s collections date back to Ole Worm’s Cabinet of Curiosities from around 1620. With 14 million preserved specimens and living plants of 8,000 different species in the Botanical Garden, it is the largest museum collection in Denmark. It covers our planetary history with botanical, zoological, and geological specimens from all over the world. Read more about the Mammalia collection here.

The Natural History Museum Denmark is part of the University of Copenhagen, which was founded in 1479 and is the largest university in Denmark. Read more about the museum here.
Inquiries about the position can be made to Museum Director Nina Rønsted (e-mail: nronsted@snm.ku.dk).

Affirmative action
The Natural History Museum Denmark is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disabled status. We are actively promoting a strategy to improve the gender balance among scientific staff. Copenhagen is a highly diverse and international Scandinavian capital with a green profile. Education is free and childcare is subsidized. Public transport is well developed, and most Copenhageners take their bike to work. There are lots of green areas in and around Copenhagen, the water in the harbor is clean enough for swimming, and the city has multiple museums and other cultural venues.

Terms of employment
Employment is as tenure-track assistant professor/associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The successful applicant is expected to take Danish lessons if there is no prior knowledge of Danish language. The International Office at the University of Copenhagen can help.
This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPHs extensive support for international researchers here

How to apply
The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae documenting:
    • Previous positions at museums, universities, or other research or cultural institutions
    • Fundraising experience
    • International network and relations
    • Curatorial experience (curation of collections)
    • Public engagement activities, i.e. citizen science projects, exhibitions, popular lectures or other relevant activities
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc- and MSc-students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Diplomas (MSc and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, impact, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is November 2 2026 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. We work thoroughly with this process. Several professionals from different fields must be involved. Therefore, we will not be ready for interviews until February 2027.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

Please refer to the following no. in future communication: 211-0260/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor and Curator of Mammals/211-0765/26-2E Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals

title: Industriteknikker eller tillært medarbejder
description:
OJM søger industriteknikker eller tillærte medarbejdere til CNC fræseafdeling (daghold)

Er du faglært eller har erfaring med CNC-fræsning, samt masser af godt humør, lysten til at gå forrest og gøre en forskel og derved være med til at vise vejen fremadrettet, har OJM A/S jobbet til dig.

Vi er i en rivende udvikling og har derfor behov for at udvide medarbejderstaben i vores fræseafdeling på et fast daghold

Som medarbejder i vores fræseafdeling vil du spille en vigtig rolle i den løbende produktion med at holde vores maskiner i kontinuerlig drift med konstant fokus på kvalitet, output, opstilling og forbedringer. Du vil blive en del af et team på 7-8 medarbejdere, hvor din faglige kunnen, indflydelse og god kommunikation er vigtige parametre. Vi er en mangfoldig arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til den enkelte, og hvor faglig og personlig udvikling samt personlige målsætninger prioriteres højt. 

Din profil  

Vi forventer, at du:

  • har en relevant erfaring inden for CNC-bearbejdning

  • erfaring med løbende produktion, gerne på følgende maskine typer

    • Mazak HCN6000, SW442BA

  • erfaring med robot håndteret maskiner/celler

  • erfaring med tegningslæsning, brug af div. måleudstyr mm.

  • besidder IT-færdigheder på brugerniveau

 Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • har erfaring med at arbejde på aften/nathold/weekend

  • har en analytisk tilgang til opgaverne og altid prøver at finde en optimal løsning

  • evner at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig at være en god holdspiller

  • er glad, positiv og udadvendt

  Vi tilbyder:

  • et spændende job med gode og selvstændige arbejdsvilkår

  • et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel og ordentlig omgangstone

  • gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold: 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes med udgangspunkt i en vurdering af din faglige kompetencer. 

Yderligere oplysninger:

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til COO/ Fabriksdirektør – Kim Brødbæk på telefon 30518668 eller mail: kb@ojm.dk 

Ansøgningsprocedure:

Du søger stillingen ved at sende dit CV, ansøgning og relevante dokumenter til os pr. mail på adressen job@ojm.dk

title: Vild med matematik og natur/teknologi? Alkestrupskolen mangler dig i indskolingen og på mellemtrinnet!
description:
Alkestrupskolen søger en energisk og nærværende uddannet lærer, der brænder for at skabe spændende, engagerende og tryg undervisning. Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Om stillingen: Din primære opgave bliver at skabe succesoplevelser med matematik og natur/teknologi i indskolingen og på mellemtrinnet.

  • Matematik.
  • Natur/Teknologi.
  • Det er et plus, hvis du også kan dække fag som Håndværk og Design, Musik eller Madkundskab.

Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du træder ind ad døren med masser af pædagogisk energi og et hjerte, der banker for børnenes trivsel og faglige udvikling. Du er god til at opbygge relationer, trives i et tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger og kan lide at gøre undervisningen nærværende og levende. Vi har alle lidt kant – det har du også!

Hvad tilbyder vi? På Alkestrupskolen bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, søde børn og plads til forskellighed:

  • Stærkt kollegafællesskab: Du bliver en del af en engageret personalegruppe, hvor vi løfter i flok, passer på hinanden, og hvor der er plads til faglighed og udvikling - og til at være præcis den, du er.
  • Overskuelige rammer: En mindre skole, hvor alle børn og voksne kender hinanden.
  • Opbakning og natur: En meget engageret forældrekreds samt fantastiske udearealer og natur, der oplagt kan inddrages i undervisningen.

Det praktiske:

  • Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
  • Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt.
  • Ansøgning: Vi opfordrer dig til at tage kontakt til enten Souschef Christopher Folkvard tlf.: 51 16 68 22 eller skoleleder Merete Fledelius tlf.: 24 91 76 32 for et besøg på skolen fra uge 39 og frem.
  • Send din ansøgning: Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning online. Klik på ”Søg stillingen” og vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV.
  • Ansættelsessamtaler: Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

I Køge Kommune bliver du en del af en organisation med dedikerede medarbejdere, der hver dag forenes i et fælles mål om at skabe værdi for borgerne. I kommunen ser vi mangfoldighed som en ressource, og ønsker at fremme ligestillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen – uanset køn, etnisk oprindelse, religion, alder eller eventuel funktionsnedsættelse.

Så bliv en del af holdet! Vi tilbyder dig et forskelligartet arbejdsmiljø og en lang række forskellige personalegoder, såsom sociale aktiviteter og adgang til vores feriehuse.

Læs mere om Køge Kommune på www.koege.dk

title: Køkkenmedarbejder søges til Klax Greve, integreret institution
description:
Kan du lide at skabe måltider, der både ser indbydende ud og smager godt – og har du samtidig sans for orden, hygiejne og et køkken, der står flot, når dagen er slut?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

I Klax Greve søger vi en køkkenmedarbejder til en stilling på 20–25 timer om ugen. Stillingen er i første omgang et vikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse.

Et køkken, hvor det gode måltid er i centrum

Du bliver en del af et flot og velfungerende køkken, hvor maden til børnene leveres af Fru Hansens Kælder, som står for en økologisk og sund frokostordning til daginstitutioner.

Det betyder, at du ikke skal stå for den store madproduktion fra bunden. I stedet modtager vi måltidskasser med delvist tilberedte råvarer og retter, som er nemme at gøre klar.

Din opgave bliver at få det sidste til at ske.

Du skal tilberede maden, gøre den appetitlig og indbydende for børnene og sørge for, at måltiderne bliver serveret med glæde og omtanke.

Det handler ikke kun om at sætte mad på bordet. Det handler også om at skabe gode måltidsoplevelser for børnene.

Du har øje for detaljen

Når dagens måltid er serveret, sørger du for, at køkkenet igen står rent, ryddeligt og indbydende.

Du arbejder struktureret og har blik for, at alt er på plads, så næste dags forberedelser kan begynde, når du møder ind igen.

Vi forventer derfor, at du:

  • har gyldigt hygiejnebevis

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • har sans for orden, rengøring og fødevaresikkerhed

  • kan gøre maden indbydende og appetitlig

  • tager ansvar for, at køkkenet fungerer godt i hverdagen

  • møder børn og kolleger med et smil og en positiv tilgang

-Og så skal du selvfølgelig kunne lide børn

Du behøver ikke være pædagog for at arbejde hos os.

Men hvis du synes, at børn er fantastiske, og du har lyst til at være en del af deres hverdag, så er det et rigtig godt match.

Hos Klax er køkkenet nemlig også en del af det pædagogiske miljø. Børnene skal kunne mærke, at maden er lavet til dem – og måske bliver du også den, der får en lille snak med et barn, der lige kommer forbi køkkenet.

Vi tilbyder

  • en stilling på 20–25 timer om ugen

  • et vikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse

  • et flot og velfungerende køkken

  • gode råvarer og en økologisk frokostordning

  • en arbejdsplads, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af børnenes hverdag

  • kolleger, der arbejder for at skabe gode dage for børnene

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning til os – vi glæder os til at møde dig!

Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigt så du kan få mulighed for at tale med os.

title: Grow365.io is Hiring an Ambitious Account Manager for the UK Market
description:
Join Grow365.io on an exciting digital growth journey

Grow365.io is a fast-growing software company helping B2B businesses generate new customers and enter new markets through AI and automation software.

We already work with companies such as Jyllands-Posten, Kingspan, JKS and many others. We are now looking for an ambitious Account Manager to help strengthen our presence in the UK market.

You will become part of a young, energetic team based in Aarhus, Denmark, where sales, advisory and high performance go hand in hand.

About the role

As Account Manager, you will be responsible for the full sales process in the UK market – from the first contact to closing the deal.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn and Grow365.io

  • Booking and conducting online meetings with potential customers

  • Understanding customer needs and advising them on relevant solutions

  • Following up with prospects and closing deals

  • Building and maintaining strong customer relationships

  • Working closely with management and the sales team

What we offer

At Grow365.io, you will have the opportunity to build a strong international sales career in a company with high ambitions and significant growth potential.

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary combined with an attractive commission scheme

  • Uncapped earning potential

  • Strong professional and personal development opportunities

  • Thorough onboarding and training

  • Professional equipment

  • An ambitious and supportive working environment

  • A varied role in a fast-growing software company

  • Regular social and professional events

Who are you?

We are looking for someone with energy, drive and a strong desire to achieve results. You enjoy speaking with customers, building relationships and working towards clear targets.

We particularly value that you:

  • Are confident and persuasive on the phone

  • Can build trust quickly with potential customers

  • Work independently and in a structured way

  • Are comfortable making a high volume of calls

  • Are motivated by targets, results and performance

  • Take responsibility and follow through on your tasks

  • Speak and write English fluently

Previous sales experience is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important thing is your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn and develop.

Practical information

The position is based in Aarhus, Denmark, and focuses on the UK market.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact CEO Mads Thomsen on +45 50 42 04 78.

Please send your application to mads@grow365.io.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Kommunikationsmedarbejder til Museum Thy
description:
Vil du være med til at fortælle historien om Thy – og gøre den relevant for mennesker i dag?

På Museum Thy arbejder vi hver dag med at bevare, indsamle, formidle og levendegøre vores fælles kulturarv. Nu søger vi en kreativ og idérig kommunikationsmedarbejder, som kan være med til at sende museets mange historier, arrangementer og aktiviteter ud over rampen.

Som en del af et stærkt fagligt hold bliver du den, der hjælper med at sætte ord og billeder på det, der sker på museet – fra den store nye udstilling over nyeste viden fra de arkæologiske udgravninger til den lille sjove og interessante historie fra hverdagen bag facaden. Du skal have blik for den gode fortælling og have lyst til at finde den frem, så den kan engagere både vores lokale publikum, men også turister og andre kulturinteresserede.

Dine arbejdsopgaver består af forskellige eksterne kommunikationsopgaver, blandt andet:
• Sociale medier på Facebook, Instagram og LinkedIn, hvor du planlægger og producerer indhold i samarbejde med museets øvrige medarbejdere
• Pressearbejde, hvor du skriver pressemeddelelser, pitcher gode historier og har kontakten til lokale og nationale medier
• Nyhedsbrev, hvor du planlægger, producerer og udsender indhold til vores venneforening
• Hjemmeside – opdatering og produktion af indhold på museets fire hjemmesider

Vi forestiller os, at du
• har en relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for kommunikation, journalistik, formidling eller lignende
• skriver levende, sikkert og målrettet forskellige målgrupper
• har erfaring med sociale medier og digital kommunikation. Du er flydende i Meta og reels
• kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret med udgangspunkt i et samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af museets afdelinger
• er nysgerrig, opsøgende og god til at skabe relationer – ikke mindst til pressen
• har lyst til at arbejde med vores fælles fortælling om fortiden – og gøre den nærværende og relevant for nutiden
• har erfaring med foto, video, grafik og/eller andre former for digital indholdsproduktion

Har du lyst til at fortælle historierne om Thy og thyboerne?
Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter overenskomst på det kommunale område.

Arbejdssted: Hovedansættelsesstedet er Jernbanegade 4, 7700 Thisted.
Stillingen indbefatter opgaver på museets afdelinger.

Tiltrædelse og omfang: Stillingen er på 20 timer og ønskes besat snarest muligt.

Ansøgningsfrist: Ansøgning sendes på e-mail til kontakt@museumthy.dk og skal være os i hænde senest d. 30. september.

title: Montør til Bruseglas og nicher
description:
Er du en kvalitetsbevidst tømrer eller håndværker med sans for detaljen? Trives du med selvstændigt arbejde, hvor du får ansvar og frihed i hverdagen? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en dygtig medarbejder med håndværker erfaring til montering af bruseglas og nicher hos primært erhvervskunder på hele Sjælland. Du behøver ikke at være uddannet så længe du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på.

Erfaring med montagearbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du arbejder præcist, leverer høj kvalitet og sætter en ære i godt håndværk. Du vil få en grundig oplæring, hvor du de første 1½ måned følges med en erfaren kollega.

Du starter arbejdsdagen hjemmefra og modtager dagen før en arbejdsplan med dagens opgaver. Materialer hentes på vores lager i Roskilde cirka to gange om ugen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med opstart hurtigst muligt.

  • Arbejde mandag til torsdag kl. 07.30–15.30 og fredag kl. 07.30–15.00.

  • Timeløn på 225 kr. Ved fastansættelse vil lønnen være højere.

  • Firmabil, værktøj, arbejdstøj og mobiltelefon stilles til rådighed.

  • Grundig oplæring og sparring med en erfaren kollega.

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse efter 3 måneders fuldtidsansættelse

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er bosat på Sjælland og kommer med noget håndværksmæssig erfaring.

  • Har gerne erfaring med montagearbejde eller fugning.

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for detaljen.

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Taler dansk eller engelsk.

  • Har kørekort B.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdsområde: Hele Sjælland (lager i Roskilde)

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt – vi ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag til Niso@moment.dk. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Material Coordinator
description:
Brænder du for koordinering, logistik og materialestyring? Er du struktureret, serviceminded og trives med mange kontaktflader i en dynamisk hverdag? Så er du måske vores nye Material Coordinator.

Rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Material Coordinator bliver du en vigtig del af OMC-teamet, hvor du får en central rolle i at sikre effektiv håndtering af materialer, udstyr og logistiske processer mellem offshore-installationer, varehus, indkøb, leverandører og interne interessenter.

Stillingen er på 30 timer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Håndtering og koordinering af backload-processer mellem offshore og onshore lokationer.

  • Opfølgning på leveringstider og dialog med indkøb om fremrykning af materialer.

  • Koordinering med bådtransport og varehus ved modtagelse og afsendelse af materialer.

  • Sikre hurtig returnering af lejeudstyr til leverandører.

  • Oprettelse og koordinering af serviceordrer til reparation af udstyr, herunder:

  • Assistere med lukning af Repair-ordrer for at sikre korrekt håndtering af økonomiske commitments.

  • Rådgivning og support ved spørgsmål omkring materialerouting til offshore-destinationer.

  • Sparringspartner for Unisol-teamet i forbindelse med forbedringer, fejl og optimering af SAP-processer.

  • Oprettelse af manuelle Purchase Requisitions til materialeindkøb.

  • Opfølgning på kvalitetskontrol (QC) for frigivelse af materialer i samarbejde med indkøb og leverandører.

  • Gennemføre materialegennemgang på kampagnebåde samt koordinere pick/pack-aktiviteter med planlæggere, varehus og bådpersonale.

  • Opfølgning på hasteordrer og kritiske materialebehov fra offshore.

  • Koordinering af reparationer på udstyr modtaget fra offshoreinstallationer.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af transporter via vejtransport.

 

Hvem er du?

  • Har erfaring inden for logistik, supply chain, materialestyring eller lagerfunktioner

  • Har erfaring med SAP eller tilsvarende ERP-systemer

  • Er struktureret og god til at holde overblik over mange opgaver samtidigt

  • Trives med koordinering på tværs af flere afdelinger og interessenter

  • Er løsningsorienteret og har en proaktiv tilgang til opgaver

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og god kundeservice

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag i et dynamisk miljø.

  • Tæt samarbejde med offshore, indkøb, lager, logistik og teknikere.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og stor indflydelse på arbejdsprocesser.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde, videndeling og kontinuerlige forbedringer.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Deltidsstilling 30 timer, med 1 ugentlig fridag i rul med resten af teamet.

Om NorSea

House of Offshore Innovation er et kontorfællesskab med både nationale og internationale virksomheder fra energiindustrien. Vi udlejer kontor- og mødelokaler og deler husets ressourcer og viden med hinanden.

NorSea Denmark er en del af NorSea Group, og er ejet af Wilhelmsen. Vi opererer Danmarks største offshore supply base. Gennem vores one-stop-shop koncept servicerer vi energisektoren med totale supply chain løsninger.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, der hele tiden forsøger at udvikle os gennem innovation. Vores vigtigste aktiv er vores medarbejdere, og vi har det som vores mission at være Best Place to Work. Vi bor i vores nyrenoverede domicil, House of Offshore Innovation i Esbjerg. Hér tilbyder vi vores medarbejdere attraktive vilkår, herunder; personalerestaurant, fitnesslokale, aktiv personaleforening m.m.

NorSea Denmark is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to the maritime and offshore industry. The group operates 12 supply bases in the North Sea, and our base in Esbjerg is Denmark’s largest. We are part of the NorSea Group - a global provider of base operations and full service logistics solutions with 50 years of experience.

NorSea Group is owned by one of the world’s largest maritime industrial group, Wilhelmsen. As an experienced and reliable one-stop-shop, we at NorSea Denmark aim to set new industry standards for efficiency and safety. We deliver all types of logistics and base solutions to the offshore sector. With a deep understanding of our customers’ commercial interests and needs, we innovate safe and profitable solutions.

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at blive en vigtig del af forsyningskæden og sikre, at de rette materialer er tilgængelige på rette tid og sted? Så ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Michael Zdrinka Clausen, Warehouse Manager på michael.clausen@norseagroup.com eller +45 21946317

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. oktober eller når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Handyman m/k til PKA i Kolding
description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, serviceminded og typen, der gerne tager fat, når noget skal løses? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Coor søger en handyman m/k til vores PKA-kontrakt i Kolding. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og får en varieret hverdag med forskellige praktiske opgaver, hvor du er med til at sikre, at vores kundes faciliteter fungerer og fremstår ordentligt.

Du vil have en synlig rolle i huset og kommer til at samarbejde tæt med både kolleger og kundens medarbejdere. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er imødekommende, hjælpsom og god til at tage ansvar.

Dine opgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

· Praktiske service- og vedligeholdsopgaver

· Runderingsopgaver og løbende kontrol af faciliteter

· Håndtering af praktiske opgaver via en digital opgaveplatform

· Modtagelse og håndtering af varer

· Håndtering og fordeling af post

· Forefaldende praktiske opgaver, der får hverdagen til at fungere

Du skal kunne lide en hverdag, hvor opgaverne kan variere, og hvor du selv er med til at finde løsninger, når der opstår noget uventet.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

· Er praktisk anlagt og kan lide at tage fat

· Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og struktureret

· Er serviceminded og god til at samarbejde

· Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ejerskab for dine opgaver

· Er tryg ved smartphone og apps

· Har kørekort B – et krav

· Gerne har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller erfaring med lignende opgaver

· Kan sikkerhedsgodkendes af PET til PKA – et krav

Det vigtigste for os er, at du er en person, man kan regne med, og at du har lyst til at gøre en forskel i hverdagen.

Klar til at blive en del af teamet?

Hvis du kan lide en praktisk hverdag med ansvar, variation og gode kolleger, så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Da du skal arbejde på vores PKA-kontrakt, er det en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes af PET. Coor får ikke adgang til oplysningerne fra sikkerhedsundersøgelsen.

Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger på mail og opfordrer dig til at undlade foto i CV og ansøgning, da vi ønsker en så upartisk rekrutteringsproces som muligt.

title: Souschef
description:
Souschef til 7-Eleven på Herlev Hospital  
Målet er klart – vi vil være dem i "klassen”, der sætter standarderne inden for convenience og vi skal motivere til vinderkultur! 

 

Vores forventninger til dig  

I 7-Eleven er kunden vores øverste chef og har altid første prioritet. 
Som souschef er du butikschefens højre hånd og din primære opgave er at løfte salget, skabe en god stemning for kunderne og sikre en altid flot og indbydende butik.  

Du skal trives med uforudsete udfordringer og brænde for at løbe en ekstra mil når der er behov for det, altså være den der har førertrøjen på således det bliver sjovt at være både kunde og medarbejder i butikken – vi vil have det morsomt og lønsomt. 

 

Som person er det vigtigt at du kan arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt, da du i dette job vil arbejde alene det meste af tiden.  Vi ser meget gerne, at du har nogle års erfaring fra detail eller en tilsvarende stilling, men det er ikke et krav. 

 

Ansvarlig for butikkens drift 
Du har i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen, ansvaret for butikken og den daglige drift, herunder: 

  • Opnå de daglige og månedlige salgstal og budgetter 

  • Bestilling af varer 

  • Varemodtagelse og opfyldning af varer 

  • Orden og struktur på lager og kontor 

  • Tilberedning af mad 

  • Overholdelse af butikkens Egenkontrolprogram 

  • Rengøringsrutiner i butikken sættes i system 

  • Eksekvering af kampagner jf. de givne deadlines 

  • Daglig opfølgning og overholdelse af afskrivningsbudget 

  • Deltage aktivt i status med fokus på optimering af svindresultater 

  • Bidrage til overholdelse af interne retningslinjer 

  • Der forventes aktiv deltagelse i og omkring butikkens events 

  • Diverse ad hoc i en dynamisk hverdag 

Løn og ansættelsesforhold 

Vi tilbyder muligheden for at blive en del af et godt team af gode og glade kollegaer, ansvar og mulighed for at deltage i lederudviklingsaktiviteter. 

Stillingen er baseret på en 2-ugers periode: Mandag-fredag fra 7:00 – 16:00, samt hver anden lørdag. Vi holder døgnåbent 365 dage om året, og juleaften og nytårsaften går således på skift. 

Løn og ansættelsesforhold reguleres af butiksoverenskomsten samt særbestemmelser efter aftale med HK Handel. 

 

Ansøgningsfrist:  15-10-2026 
Samtaler afholdes:     løbende 

Tiltrædelse:     d. 1. November 2026 eller efter aftale

title: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do
  • Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
  • Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
  • Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
  • Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
  • Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
  • Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
  • Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
  • Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
  • Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months
  • You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
  • You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
  • You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
  • You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
  • If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
  • You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.
  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
  • Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
  • Strong C++ programming skills.
  • Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
  • Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
  • Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
  • Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
  • Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.
  • You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
  • You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
  • You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
  • You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
  • You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

title: Chaufførafløser til Meldgaard Miljø A/S (erhverv)
description:
Kunne du tænke dig et fleksibelt chaufførjob med afvekslende arbejdsopgaver?  

I Meldgaard Miljø ser vi et stort potentiale i, at vi i Danmark bliver bedre til sortering af affald. Derfor hjælper vi alle typer af virksomheder med at indfri deres fulde potentiale med hensyn til korrekt sortering og genanvendelse.

Om jobbet
Vi søger en chaufførafløser til kørsel på genbrugspladser i Sønderborg. 
Det vil primært være weekend, men kan også være hverdage eller som tilkald i ferier og ved behov generelt. 
Aflønning ift. overenskomst DIO I (ATL) og 3F. 

Om dig
Det er vigtigt, at du er omhyggelig, serviceminded og ansvarsfuld, da du ofte bliver den første kunderne møder, når de har lavet en aftale med os.

Vi forventer, at du er fleksibel, positiv og en god kollega.


Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelses- forhold i en velkonsolideret familievirksomhed med over 55 års erfaring. 

Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte formand Tobias Haarnagel på tlf. 52 18 76 79 eller send din ansøgning via Ansøg senest den 18. oktober 2026. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

title: Service Employee in Denmark
description:
We are looking for a responsible and flexible Service Employee for a varied position with responsibility for the daily service and practical operations at our premises in Strandgade.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys a varied working day, works independently, and takes pride in creating well-organised and presentable surroundings for employees, guests, meetings and events.

Your responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Cooking and preparing meals

  • Planning and preparing dinners in connection with meetings, events and special occasions

  • Preparing, arranging and serving food and refreshments at meetings, dinners and events

  • Purchasing food, beverages, cleaning supplies and other necessary items

  • Planning purchases and managing stock levels

  • Daily cleaning and tidying of the kitchen, meeting rooms, offices, restrooms and other common areas

  • Ensuring that the premises are always clean, tidy and presentable

  • Preparing meeting rooms before and after meetings

  • Welcoming and assisting guests

  • Washing dishes and cleaning up after meetings, dinners and events

  • Other practical and service-related tasks connected with the daily operations

About you

We expect that you:

  • Have experience with cooking and general kitchen duties

  • Have experience with, or are willing to undertake, cleaning and practical service tasks

  • Have a strong sense of quality, order and attention to detail

  • Are service-minded and welcoming

  • Are able to work independently and take responsibility for your tasks

  • Are good at planning and structuring your working day

  • Are flexible regarding working hours

  • Are prepared to work evenings when required in connection with dinners, meetings and events

Experience from restaurants, hotels, catering, facility services or a similar service role is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We offer

An independent and varied position with considerable influence over the planning of your daily tasks.

You will become an important part of the daily operations and will have regular contact with both employees and guests.

Position: Full-time

Working hours: Working hours will be scheduled according to the company’s activities and may include both daytime and evening work in connection with meetings, dinners and events.

Place of work: Strandgade 81a, 1401 København K

Salary: Based on qualifications and agreement

Start date: By agreement

Send your application with information about your background and motivation for applying to Karin Petrovics at email karin@mindegaardgroup.dk. Apply as soon as possible.

title: Vedligeholdelsestekniker til Aarhus Havn
description:
Er du en dygtig maskinarbejder, smed eller mekaniker, der elsker fejlfinding og mekanisk vedligehold? Randstad søger for Aarhus Havn en alsidig kollega til en af byens mest centrale og spændende arbejdspladser.

Vi leder efter dig, der har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og trives med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt – fra præcis mekanik på værkstedet til vedligehold af maskiner i højden. Her bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med en stolt kultur og prioriterer det sociale fællesskab højt.

Om jobbet

Som vores nye vedligeholdelsestekniker bliver du en del af et dedikeret team, der sikrer, at alt materiel kører optimalt.
Din primære opgave er løbende drift og vedligehold, så nedbrud på kritisk udstyr undgås.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Vedligehold og fejlfinding på maskiner som kraner, løftegrej, grabber osv.

  • Mekaniske opgaver med drejebænk, fræser, måleteknik og lettere svejsning.

  • Montageopgaver og deltagelse i optimeringsprojekter eller større ombygninger.

  • Håndtering af akutte nedbrud i en omskiftelig hverdag.

Arbejdet kan være fysisk krævende og foregår i alle typer vejr – både på landjorden og i højderne. Det er derfor et krav, at du ikke har højdeskræk.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en profil med et svendebrev inden for metalområdet – f.eks. som maskinarbejder, industritekniker, smed eller entreprenør-/landbrugsmekaniker.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er yderst serviceminded, imødekommende og trives med alsidige opgaver.

  • Trives i et til tider hektisk miljø, hvor prioriteringerne kan skifte hurtigt ved akutte behov.

  • Er en udpræget holdspiller, der har lyst til at indgå i et stærkt kollegialt sammenhold, hvor man også prioriterer sociale sammenkomster og har det godt sammen.

  • Har solid erfaring med vedligehold og fejlfinding på tungt materiel eller produktionsudstyr.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og sætter sikkerheden højest – både for dig selv og andre.

  • Har kørekort B, samt truckcertifikat. Har du kran C, løftegrejsbevis og teleskoplæsser, er det et plus men ikke et krav.

  • Er fortrolig med IT og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Vi tilbyder

En spændende arbejdsplads på Aarhus Havn, hvor to dage sjældent er ens.

  • Arbejdstid: 37 timer ugentligt (kl. 7.00-15.00, fredag til kl. 14.30) med betalt frokostpause.

  • Ingen fast vagt: Der er ingen tvungen vagtordning eller udkald, men du kan blive spurgt om frivilligt overarbejde og tilkald ved kritiske maskinstop.

  • Gode personaleforhold: Kantineordning, sundhedsordning, omsorgsdage, seniordage, aktiv idræts-, kunst- og personaleforening.

  • Parkering: Gratis parkering ved arbejdspladsen.

Ansøgning

Aarhus Havn samarbejder med Randstad i denne rekruttering. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte chef konsulent v. Randdstad, Stine Høgsted på telefon: 92 92 37 85.

Aarhus Havn ønsker tiltrædelse snarest muligt, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Chef / Head Chef – Le Diamant Bistro
description:
Job Title

Chef / Head Chef – Le Diamant Bistro

Job Description

Le Diamant Bistro in Copenhagen K is looking for a passionate and experienced Chef / Head Chef to join our team and help build an exciting new restaurant concept.

You will have an important role in developing our menu, creating great food and establishing an efficient and professional kitchen operation from the beginning.

Your main responsibilities

  • Prepare and develop dishes for the restaurant menu

  • Contribute to menu and concept development

  • Manage daily food preparation and kitchen production

  • Ensure consistent quality, taste and presentation

  • Organise kitchen workflow and daily operations

  • Manage stock, ordering and kitchen costs

  • Train, support and motivate kitchen staff

  • Maintain high standards of food safety, hygiene and cleanliness

  • Help create a positive and professional working environment

For the Head Chef position, you will also have responsibility for the overall kitchen operation and team leadership.

Qualifications

We are looking for a chef who is passionate about food, reliable, creative and enjoys working as part of a team.

Required

  • Proven professional experience as a Chef

  • Experience working in a busy restaurant environment

  • Good knowledge of kitchen operations and food safety

  • Good organisational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure

  • Good English communication skills

  • A professional and positive attitude

For the Head Chef position

  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience

  • Ability to train and motivate kitchen staff

  • Experience with ordering, stock management and kitchen organisation

  • Ability to take responsibility for the daily kitchen operation

An advantage

  • Experience with menu development

  • Experience from casual dining or street food

  • Experience from international or creative kitchens

  • Experience opening or developing a new restaurant

  • Interest in innovative and modern cooking

Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

We Offer

  • Full-time permanent employment

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • The opportunity to help build Le Diamant Bistro from the beginning

  • A dynamic and international working environment

  • Opportunity to contribute your own ideas and creativity

  • Professional development and increased responsibility

  • A central location in Copenhagen K

Application

Are you an experienced Chef or Head Chef looking for an exciting opportunity to be part of a new restaurant concept?

We would love to hear from you.

Please send us your CV and a short introduction about yourself, your experience and why you would like to join Le Diamant Bistro.

description:

Om stillingen:

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder til vores specialiserede butik med fokus på japanske kvalitetsknive og japansk knivhåndværk.

Stillingen er en kombination af salg og kundeservice, arbejde med slibning af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen kombinerer salg og kundeservice med praktisk arbejde, slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

En væsentlig del af stillingen indebærer direkte kommunikation med japanske producenter og leverandører. Derfor er gode japanske sprogkundskaber en nødvendighed kompetence i stillingen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Salg og rådgivning af kunder om japanske kvalitetsknive og tilbehør.

Kundeservice og vejledning om valg, brug og vedligeholdelse af knive.

Slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive, samt indgravering i hånden.

Modtagelse, kontrol og håndtering af varer.

Vare- og lagerstyring.

Kommunikation med japanske leverandører og producenter,

Håndtering af profuktinformation, ordrer, specifikationer og leverancer.

Oversættelse og videreformidling af information mellem virksomheden og japanske leverandører.

Bidrage til den daglige drift og præsentation af butikken.

Vi forventer, at du:

Taler og skriver japansk på højt niveau.

Kan kommunikere proffesionelt med vores japanske leverandører både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Har interesse for japanske knive, håndværk og kvalitet.

Har gode kundeservice- og salgsevner.

Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Har interesse for eller erfaring med knivslibning.

title: PhD Stipend in Digital Twin Modelling and Multi-Timescale Optimization of Electrolysis Systems
description:
Help to build the digital backbone of tomorrow's Power-to-X plants. This 3-year PhD position offers a unique opportunity to build a research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems. You will drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies, integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand, to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolysers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University, and research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
You will develop and validate digital-twin and optimization methods for electrolysis systems, working both independently and collaboratively with the group and with academic and industrial partners. In particular, you will:

  • Develop and validate physics-based, data-driven, or hybrid digital twins of Electrolysis systems, capturing their electrochemical, thermal, flow, and system-level behaviour for system monitoring, state estimation, and performance prediction.
  • Build computationally efficient models suitable for monitoring, performance prediction, optimization, and control, and evaluate their accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and practical applicability. They could also be implemented in real-time systems.
  • Investigate interactions across operational timescales (Multi-timescale optimization) — from short-term power, thermal, and flow management to longer-term production scheduling and energy-system operation — connecting fast system dynamics with slower operational decisions.
  • Develop optimization strategies to improve Electrolyzer performance, efficiency, flexibility, and economic operation under variable electricity supply and renewable-energy integration.
  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project activities.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies 
We expect you to have:

  • A relevant master's degree in energy engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, control engineering, or a related discipline.
  • A strong foundation in at least one of: electrochemical or energy-system modelling, dynamic modelling and control, mathematical optimization, or data-driven modelling.
  • Experience with numerical modelling, simulation, optimization, control, or engineering-data analysis.
  • Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or a comparable scientific computing environment.
  • A fundamental understanding of energy-conversion systems, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, heat and mass transfer, electrochemistry, or control engineering.
  • The ability to conduct independent, systematic, and scientifically rigorous research while working effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with some of the areas of electrolyzer technologies, digital twins, model order reduction, system identification, power electronics, model predictive control, multi-objective optimization, machine learning, renewable-energy integration, experimental testing, or hardware-in-the-loop implementation would be an advantage. You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are
The PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • A project description (3–5 pages) outlining your initial thoughts and ideas on the project applied for, including a brief state-of-the-art with a short list of references, a time schedule, and how you intend to address the project objectives.
  • Publications, if applicable.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
